artifact.summary: Bi-encoder is production primary for v6 transcript routing; cross-encoder remains code-reachable behind the v6.routing.reranker_mode flag (P10 CONTEXT decision 1).

transcript_chunks.body: The cross-encoder underperformed our cosine baseline on the substrate fitness re-check. Why isn't it the default if it's the more sophisticated model?

Distribution mismatch. The model was trained on the document-style web distribution; our substrate is the conversation distribution. The binding measurement was conducted under the cosine baseline, so methodology says we ship what was bound — promotion happens after a re-bind on a grown corpus, not before.
